items.headline: Turkey's largest refiner signs US agency deal to study SMRs
items.what_happened: Tupras, Turkey's largest crude oil refiner, signed a cooperation agreement with the US Trade and Development Agency on 24 October 2026. The agreement covers a study of small modular reactor technology in technical, economic and potential industrial terms. WNN reports the refiner wants SMR power, heat and steam for its refining processes, and that the study is scheduled to take about one year.
items.why_it_matters: A refinery needs process steam, heat and electricity at a steady scale, so it is a plausible industrial buyer for a 1-20 MW reactor. This is a study with no named vendor, reactor or site, so it signals interest rather than a purchase.
items.binding_note: A cooperation agreement to study SMRs. The sources read name no grant amount, reactor design or vendor, so no equipment or power commitment is executed.
